title: EvalDocResult
description: Output of `model eval` — the real kernel's runtime verdict over a document INSTANCE: which rules fired on the data (validateFull). Computations are NOT run; a computed field reads as whatever the document supplies. The INPUT --doc is a nested tree under "fields" (repeatable group = array of row objects, non-repeatable group = nested object, field = its text value; null/"" = present-but-unfilled, an absent key = no instance).

fired.description: the distinct error codes that fired, in first-seen order

messages.description: every message the kernel raised, in kernel order

rule.description: present only when narrowed to one rule (--rule or a candidate --condition/--field)

fired.description: whether that rule fired on the document

code.description: the rule's error code, or a kernel formal-error code

rule.description: the firing rule's full slash-path (e.g. /Order/X); a kernel FORMAL check reports the sentinel 'formalePruefung' — a leading '/' is the author-rule discriminator

field.description: the offending field's instance pointer — path with the repetition index on each group segment, e.g. /Order[1]/Items[2]/Count — the row it hit

message.description: the INTERPOLATED end-user text — the authored message with $Field$/$Field.value$ tokens resolved against this document (what the user actually reads, G1)

referenced.description: the fields the rule READ (its operands), as instance pointers — the kernel's referencedFields

fillToFix.description: for an OMISSION error, the operand fields that — if filled/changed — would clear it (the kernel's refOmissionErrorResponsible); absent for a VALUE error
